items.title: Critical Unpatched Telnetd Flaw (CVE-2026-32746) Enables Unauthenticated Root RCE via Port 23
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed a critical security flaw impacting the GNU InetUtils telnet daemon (telnetd) that could be exploited by an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-32746, carries a CVSS score of 9.8 out of 10.0. It has been described as a case of out-of-bounds write in the LINEMODE Set

items.title: Microsoft Teams Support Call Leads to Quick Assist Compromise in New Vishing Attack
items.description: Microsoft Detection and Response Team details a sophisticated voice phishing (vishing) campaign that successfully compromised a corporate environment in November 2025.
